Pakistani officials allege Taliban shelling of border posts; Afghan side denies

On September 23, Pakistani officials in Peshawar said Afghan Taliban forces shelled border posts overnight, claiming Pakistani troops had foiled a cross‑border infiltration attempt. Taliban government spokesman Zabiullah Mujahi denied that any attack took place.
